title: Printable Crochet Pattern Bundle | Autumn Table Decor, 6 Patterns, Instant Digital Download
description:
Bring a little crisp autumn warmth to your crochet time and make seasonal pieces for the table. 🍂 This Falling Leaves Crochet Table Set brings together six patterns with a romantic, cosy, tactile feel.

From a maple leaf placemat in burnt orange to a warm oatmeal or natural falling-leaves table runner, the collection centres on foliage-inspired table décor. The pieces can be worked individually or brought together for an autumnal table arrangement.

Pattern highlights

The Maple Leaf Placemat is a foliage piece measuring about 38 cm wide by 35 cm long. The Falling Leaves Table Runner measures about 100 cm long by 28 cm wide. Add smaller details with the Beech Leaf Coaster, about 12 cm long including its stem, or the Acorn Napkin Ring with its rust-brown body and textured dark-brown cap. The Chestnut Cutlery Pocket offers another seasonal element for the table.

What you receive

• 6 crochet patterns
• 24-page complete collection PDF
• Each pattern as its own PDF
• Step-by-step written instructions
• US crochet terms
• A4 and US Letter printing formats
• Pattern index, materials and tools reference, and abbreviations reference
• Printing and crochet guide
• 3 Autumn Table Styling Ideas

How it works

Download the files instantly, choose the pattern you would like to make, print the relevant pages in A4 or US Letter, gather the materials listed in the reference, and start crocheting. Skill levels across the collection include Beginner, Easy and Intermediate.

Make one seasonal detail or combine pieces for a layered table setting. It is a lovely way to enjoy unhurried hook-and-yarn time as autumn arrives. 🍁

This is a digital download delivered in 2 ZIP files of PDF files. No physical item is shipped. No yarn, hook or kit is included.
